overview:
Chris Smith has represented this Monmouth and Ocean County district since 1981, making him one of the longest-serving House members and a fixture of New Jersey politics. The seat leans Republican by roughly fourteen points, and Smith has consistently defeated Democratic challengers even in years favorable to the opposition. Rachel Peace enters the general election with modest resources, about $14,000 on hand against Smith's $553,000, and no meaningful outside spending has emerged on either side.

No public polls cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, fundraising, and prediction markets, where Polymarket prices Smith's chances near 96 percent. A strong Democratic national environment could narrow the margin, but Smith's incumbency advantage and the district's partisan lean make an upset a low-probability outcome. The expected result is a solid Republican win in the low-to-mid teens.
